description:
A phase-shifting transformer regulating the phase angle between two buses to control active power flow in the system.

The model uses an equivalent circuit assuming the impedance is on the High Voltage Side of the transformer. The model allocates the iron losses and magnetizing susceptance to the primary side.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `PowerLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `PowerLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

active_power_flow.description: Initial condition of active power flow through the transformer.

reactive_power_flow.description: Initial condition of reactive power flow through the transformer.

arc.description: An Arc defining this transformer `from` a bus `to` another bus.

tap.description: Normalized tap changer position for voltage control, varying between 0 and 2, with 1 centered at the nominal voltage.

alpha.description: Initial condition of phase shift between the `from` and `to` buses.

rating.description: Thermal rating. Flow through the transformer must be between -`rating` and `rating`.

base_power.description: Base power of the unit for per unitization.

phase_angle_limits.description: Minimum and maximum phase angle limits.

control_objective.description: Control objective for the tap changer for power flow calculations.

title: PhaseShiftingTransformer
